audit_groups.finding: The shape, level, signed tensor isometries, mutual orthogonality and shifted Casimir scalars match SumIoPr and the original projection theorem. No positive norm isometry of an indefinite inclusion is presumed.

The exact identity 2kappa-c_G-||Lambda||^2 cancels all quadratic parameter terms. Orthogonal weight decomposition gives the required diagonal lower bound. Explicit estimates then prove n times off-diagonal energy <=(B/16)^2 at level <=4n^2+2.

Projection from the dual standard tensor adds at most sqrt(n) to compact energy; comparison of the shifted lowest-weight scalar gives the target level j+2. Inclusion followed by coordinate contraction adds one further sqrt(n), so every projected component is also at level j+2 in the original module.

audit_groups.finding: V is the finite span of the actual projected vector components, invariant under T. D need not preserve V: its weight bounds and the small off-diagonal estimate still give a lower bound for z-T on V, hence the inverse bound. The stated circle separates the two spectral intervals with distance15B/32.

audit_groups.topic: Exponent independent of compact cluster size
audit_groups.finding: The contour gives the combined compact projection norm18/13. Its eigenspaces have nonnegative indefinite form because their negative coordinates are small. Orthogonality therefore sums the compact cluster once. Polynomial interpolation involves only m exceptional eigenvalues, giving the original exponent2m.

The estimates include an empty compact cluster and the zero vector. The supplied Pieri tensor decomposition and shifted modules are retained; no existence theorem, Bessel mass identity or degree-normalized lowering scalar is proved by this package.
